data-mono.purpose: JetBrains Mono, 8.5-10px/600 — count pills, kbd hints, timestamps, provenance. Mono means data, never prose.

shadows.name: chrome-pop
shadows.purpose: Popovers and floating panels over the graph canvas.

shadows.name: chrome-card
shadows.purpose: Floating capsules and cards in the landing chrome.

shadows.name: dash-card
shadows.purpose: Dashboard glass cards — deep cast plus faint blue ambience.

shadows.name: cta-glow
shadows.purpose: The one sanctioned glow: the primary CTA's accent shadow.

shadows.name: app-md
shadows.purpose: Legacy app-scale mid elevation (light mode); dark swaps to navy casts.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Global default easing; 150ms duration on background, color, border, shadow, transform.

motion.name: cta-hover
motion.purpose: Primary CTA brightens 6% on hover; active nudges down 1px. No elevation change anywhere else.

components.name: Primary CTA
components.description: The surface's one primary action (e.g. "Find open calls") — Signal Blue fill with the sanctioned accent glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 9px 12px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; background: #47a9ff; color: #fff; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(63, 147, 255, 0.22); transition: filter 0.14s ease, box-shadow 0.14s ease; } .ds-btn-cta:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(63, 147, 255, 0.22); } .ds-btn-cta:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9ccafd; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-cta-count { margin-left: auto; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18); font: 600 10px 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Command-bar / rail icon button: transparent at rest, accent tint on hover, inset hairline ring when active.
components.css: .ds-iconbtn-row { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; padding: 8px; background: #0b1437; border-radius: 12px; } .ds-iconbtn { width: 28px; height: 28px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #a9bdd6; cursor: pointer; padding: 0; transition: background 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-iconbtn:hover { background: rgba(63, 147, 255, 0.16); color: #6cb8ff; } .ds-iconbtn.is-active { background: rgba(63, 147, 255, 0.16); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(95, 148, 232, 0.4); color: #6cb8ff; } .ds-iconbtn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9ccafd; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Money Badge — Advertised
components.description: The blue half of the Two-Halves Rule: indicative work-programme money on offer. Cursor is help — it explains, it doesn't act.
components.css: .ds-money-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.5; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; padding: 1px 8px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid transparent; cursor: help; user-select: none; } .ds-money-badge--advertised { color: #7bb4ff; background: rgba(63, 139, 255, 0.12); border-color: rgba(63, 139, 255, 0.42); }

components.name: Money Badge — Awarded
components.description: The green half: real euros already awarded to CORDIS-funded projects.
components.css: .ds-money-badge2 { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.5; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; padding: 1px 8px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid transparent; cursor: help; user-select: none; } .ds-money-badge2--awarded { color: #57d98a; background: rgba(34, 178, 94, 0.13); border-color: rgba(34, 178, 94, 0.44); }

components.name: Segmented Tabs
components.description: Sub-tab strip (evidence band, dashboard tools): soft inset strip, Signal Blue active segment.
components.css: .ds-segtabs { display: inline-flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 2px; background: rgba(10, 22, 40, 0.8); border-radius: 10px; padding: 3px; } .ds-segtab { all: unset; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 8px; color: #a9bdd6; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-segtab:hover { color: #d7e6f7; } .ds-segtab--active { background: #47a9ff; color: #fff; } .ds-segtab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9ccafd; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: The blue-glass panel: translucent navy surface, hairline border, blur, structural shadow.

components.name: Quiet Input
components.description: Search / form field: quiet dark well, visible focus ring, 14px/400 text.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 240px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(82, 111, 160, 0.3); border-radius: 8px; background: #0c1740; color: #d7e6f7; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.5; transition: border-color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #7e93b3; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: rgba(95, 148, 232, 0.4); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: rgba(95, 148, 232, 0.55); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(63, 147, 255, 0.16); }

narrative.overview:
A calm instrument for watching a landscape. The interface is a set of glass panels floating over a deep-navy field — the full-bleed graph canvas owns the screen, and the chrome sits above it as translucent, blurred panes. The visitor is a professional on a recurring monitoring visit: the design's job is to let real evidence be read at a distance, quickly and without drama. Nothing shouts; the data is loud, the chrome is quiet.

The voice is calm, precise, evidential — the product's honesty contract expressed as an aesthetic. Money figures always carry their provenance badge, empty states are styled deliberately rather than hidden, and small monospace readouts mark the places where the interface is reporting fact rather than decoration. Dark mode is the reference design; light mode is a translucent-white daylight adaptation of the same architecture, not a separate identity.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed canvas; all chrome floats as blurred glass panels above it
Deep navy field, one restrained blue accent, semantic green/amber/magenta signals
Inter for prose and controls; JetBrains Mono strictly for data readouts
Tint-based interaction (no lift, no glow on hover); hairline borders everywhere
Dual token vocabularies: --lc-* (landing chrome) and --d2-* (dashboard), both dark-first with a light adaptation

rules.name: The Quiet Chrome Rule
rules.body: Chrome speaks only in tints of Signal Blue (10–22% alpha) and hairlines. Green, amber, slate, and magenta are semantic — they mark data states (open, closing, closed, counts), never decoration.

rules.name: The Two-Halves Rule
rules.body: Every euro figure wears its half: Advertised money is badged blue ("Indicative · on offer"), Awarded money is badged green ("Awarded · CORDIS"). The colors never swap and never appear unbadged on a money figure.

rules.name: The Blue-Glass-Wins Rule
rules.body: The global dark theme still carries a legacy Vision-UI purple (--primary: #7551ff) on older surfaces. New work never extends the purple: landing chrome and dashboard both override to Signal Blue, and that is the direction of travel.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-Data Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono appears only where the UI reports data — counters, keyboard hints, timestamps, provenance. Never in prose, labels, or headings.

rules.name: The Tint-Not-Lift Rule
rules.body: State changes are acknowledged with a background tint and an inset ring; shadows never change on hover.

dos: Do define both theme sets for any new chrome: the dark --lc-*/--d2-* values are the reference; light mode is the daylight adaptation. A token defined in only one mode is a bug.
Do use the _breakpoints.scss tokens/mixins (480/600/900/1100/1280) for every media query; they are mirrored into the MUI theme.
Do badge every money figure with its half (advertised blue / awarded green) and keep provenance lines ("Source: EU CORDIS · as of …") on every evidence surface.
Do style empty states deliberately — italic, muted, in place — when data is missing but the mechanism works ("no CORDIS data ingested for this area yet").
Do keep interaction quiet: accent tint + inset 0 0 0 1px ring for hover/active; 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) transitions.
Do pair color with a second channel (label, shape, position) — node-type and status colors never carry meaning alone; keep WCAG AA contrast, visible focus, keyboard paths, and reduced-motion support.
donts: Don't extend the legacy Vision-UI purple (#7551ff) to any new surface; Signal Blue glass is the direction of travel.
Don't use JetBrains Mono for prose or spend green/amber/magenta on decoration — mono means data, semantic colors mean state.
Don't ship an inert control. A mechanism that doesn't work is removed, not styled (ADR-0006 §2); a dead button lies.
Don't dress numbers up: no odds, no funded-rates, counts ≠ euros ≠ impact, and Advertised money never wears an Awarded label or color.
Don't let user-facing copy say "graph", "nodes", or "edges" — mechanism words are banned; say "in one place".
Don't add elevation on hover, gradient text, or glow effects beyond the CTA's sanctioned accent shadow.
